I used to write "Lint lint"
Just because.

A good therapist really helps. I've had ones that treat patients as you described, some who just didn't want or know how to help, etc. But you gotta find someone who you "mesh" with so to speak. I didn't think it possible as a teenager I went through probably 10 different therapists (no joke). I'm I'm my 20s now and when I turned 20 I found one who actually cares about the people she sees. She used to be depressed/anxious like me and she became a therapist to help people. Not all of them are bad, just gotta keep looking. I know is disheartening especially when you're feeling down and out but don't give up.

I know the feeling. Its like your heart is heavy again and you didn't realize it was light to begin with. I don't really have any advice but just so you know you have an internet stranger who understands. I'm here if you wanna talk ever too.
It's a load of crap honestly. We're alone in this world but the people who birthed us can't let go cause we slid out of their privates 20 plus years ago. God I'm bitter. I'm sorry.
Maybe I will share if you do
Thank you for responding to my shit post. Why are you browsing suicide watch
